'''Liam Tiglar''' is an [[Andoran]] [[Asha'man]].

==History==
He is employed by [[Mazrim Taim]] to spy on the various noble houses of [[Cairhien]] when the city is ruled in the name of the [[Dragon Reborn]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
